mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) carries nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk; abacavir metabolism does not significantly alter amikacin clearance, but renal impairment from amikacin may affect abacavir levels.
action: Monitor renal function closely during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative antibiotic if renal compromise develops; no dose adjustment of abacavir typically needed unless renal function declines.
